turnOff: Don't need tips? Turn them off in Profile.

pref.title: Preferences
pref.tipsDesc: A small Tips button on each page explains how it works.

balance.title: Balance at a glance
balance.body: Plus means money is left over; minus means money is owed. It updates as soon as something is added.

mealRate.title: Why the meal rate moves
mealRate.body: Meal rate = approved bazaar ÷ total meals so far, so it changes during the month and is fixed when the month closes.

approvals.title: Approve bazaar here
approvals.body: New bazaar from members shows up on the dashboard; approve or reject it without opening the Bazaar page.

everyone.title: Everyone's numbers
everyone.body: Tap “Everyone's summary” on My Summary to see every member's meals, bill and balance.

bell.title: What changed?
bell.body: The bell shows new activity since you last looked; open it to see who did what.

invite.title: Invite someone
invite.body: Tap Invite Member and search by name or email. They accept from the banner on their own dashboard.

create.title: No phone or email?
create.body: Create Member opens an account for them with a password you set. Ask them to change it later in Profile.

remove.title: Someone moved out
remove.body: Settle their balance first, then Remove. Their past months stay in the records.

filters.title: Find a member
filters.body: Search by name or email, or filter by role and status. Removed members are under “Removed”.

card.title: Reading a card
card.body: Current balance includes anything carried from last month. Plus = they have money left, minus = they owe.

date.title: Pick the day
date.body: Use the arrows or the calendar. Meals are saved only for past days, so record today's meals tomorrow.

count.title: Set the count
count.body: Tap + and − for each member and meal. Half meals (0.5) are fine.

everyone.title: Everyone at once
everyone.body: The “everyone” row sets a meal for all members together, which is quicker for normal days.

save.title: Don't forget to save
save.body: Changes are kept only after you tap Save.

types.title: Meal types
types.body: Add, rename or turn off meal types (breakfast, lunch, dinner…) and set how many each counts by default.

member.title: For members
member.body: Only managers can change meals. You can check your meals here and on Reports.

add.title: Add what you bought
add.body: Add each item with its price; the total is worked out for you. Pick the day you shopped.

pending.title: Pending first
pending.body: A new bazaar waits for a manager. Until then you can still edit or delete it.

approve.title: Approving
approve.body: Check items and total, then Approve, or Reject if something is wrong. Approved bazaar is locked.

rate.title: What counts
rate.body: Only approved bazaar goes into the meal rate.

date.title: Dates
date.body: The date must be in the current month and not in the future.

shared.title: Shared
shared.body: For bills everyone pays (gas, internet, maid). It is split equally between the members you select.

individual.title: Individual
individual.body: For something only one member owes. It goes straight onto their bill.

noBazaar.title: Don't add bazaar here
noBazaar.body: Approved bazaar becomes an expense automatically. Adding it again would count it twice.

fix.title: Made a mistake?
fix.body: Edit or delete an expense from Reports → Expenses (pencil icon) until the month closes.

record.title: Every payment
record.body: Record each amount a member gives to the mess, with the date they paid.

balance.title: Balances update at once
balance.body: The member's balance changes as soon as the deposit is saved.

carried.title: Carried money
carried.body: Last month's extra money comes in automatically when a month closes; don't add it again as a deposit.

fix.title: Made a mistake?
fix.body: Edit or delete a deposit from Reports → Deposits (pencil icon) until the month closes.

tabs.title: Four reports
tabs.body: Meals, Expenses, Deposits and Bazaar of the active month, newest first.

filters.title: Filter and load more
filters.body: Use the chips to filter, and Load more for older entries.

edit.title: Edit or delete
edit.body: Managers can fix expenses and deposits with the pencil icon on each row.

past.title: Older months
past.body: Closed months' full summaries are on the Months page.

start.title: Start a month
start.body: Everything you record goes into the active month. Name it after the month, e.g. “December 2026”.

close.title: Closing
close.body: Close & start new shows everyone's final balance first. Choose whether balances carry forward, and leave anyone out if needed.

final.title: Can't be undone
final.body: A closed month can't be changed, so check meals, bazaar and deposits before closing.

history.title: Past months
history.body: Tap a closed month to see its full summary: meal rate, bills and balances.

what.title: Everything in one place
what.body: Every change in the mess, with what it was about and who did it.

filter.title: Filter
filter.body: Use the chips to see only meals, expenses, deposits, bazaar, members or months.

badge.title: The red badge
badge.body: Opening this page marks everything as seen and clears the badge on the bell.

info.title: Mess details
info.body: Change the mess name, its link name (slug) and description.

slug.title: Slug
slug.body: Use small letters, numbers and dashes only, e.g. green-view-mess.

managers.title: Managers
managers.body: Hand over your manager role, add a co-manager or step down under Managers. A mess can have at most 2 managers, with the same permissions.

who.title: Who is this for?
who.body: Members without their own email or phone. You choose their login and password.

after.title: Afterwards
after.body: Give them the login. They can change the password any time from Profile.
